scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/tui build && bun run --cwd packages/ai build && bun run --cwd packages/agent build && bun run --cwd packages/coding-agent build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && bun run check:pinned-deps && bun run check:ts-imports && bun run check:shrinkwrap && bun run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:browser-smoke
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && bun install --lockfile-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build && bun run check
